description: This is a Java class representing a data transfer object for search requests related to transactions in the Fineract platform. It contains fields for search criteria such as date ranges, amount ranges, transaction types, and account identifiers, along with methods for building and configuring these search queries.

classes.name: TransactionSearchRequest
classes.description: A class encapsulating search criteria for transaction queries, with methods to fluently build parameterized search requests.

methods.name: accountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID for the transaction search.

methods.name: fromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for transaction date filtering, parsing input string into LocalDate.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for transaction date filtering, parsing input string into LocalDate.

methods.name: fromSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for submitted date filtering, parsing input string into LocalDate.

methods.name: toSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for submitted date filtering, parsing input string into LocalDate.

methods.name: types
methods.description: Sets the transaction types from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: credit
methods.description: Filters for credit transactions if true.

methods.name: debit
methods.description: Filters for debit transactions if true.

methods.name: pageable
methods.description: Configures the pagination and sorting of the search results.
